description.en: Specifies whether to process incremental callback data from the IdP.
The configurations for LDAP push synchronization.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-identity-provider-ud-push-configuration --instance-id eiam-111ccc1111 --identity-provider-id idp_11111 --incremental-callback-status disabled --periodic-sync-status disabled --ud-sync-scope-configs '[{"SourceScopes":["ou_1212xxxx"],"TargetScope":"6537211"}]' --periodic-sync-config '{"PeriodicSyncCron":"0_45_1_0_0_0","PeriodicSyncTimes":[3],"PeriodicSyncType":"cron"}' --ldap-ud-push-config UserRdn=cn PasswordSyncStatus=enabled OrganizationalUnitRdn=ou OrganizationUnitObjectClass=ou,top UserObjectClass=user,top --region cn-hangzhou
